gloss: end; tip; extremity; lowest level; retail level

definitions.explanation: The far end or outermost part of something that extends or branches out, such as the tips of nerves or the hands and feet.

definitions.gloss: lowest level; bottom rung (of an organization)
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively for the bottom of a hierarchy: the people furthest from the top of an organization.

definitions.gloss: end of a distribution chain; retail level
definitions.explanation: The last stage of distribution, where goods reach the final buyer, as in {末端|まったん}{価格|かかく} (retail price; for illegal drugs, street value) and {末端|まったん}{消費者|しょうひしゃ} (end consumer). Mostly found in business and news language.

notes:
{末端|まったん} is the far end of something that extends or branches outward: the tips of the body (sense 1), the bottom of a hierarchy (sense 2), or the last link in a chain of distribution (sense 3).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末端|まったん}: nerve endings (sense 1)
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末端|まったん}: fingertips (sense 1)
- {末端|まったん}⟦{冷|ひ}え{性|しょう}→冷え性：18211_hieshou⟧: cold hands and feet (sense 1)
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末端|まったん}: the lowest level of an organization (sense 2)
- {末端|まったん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: rank-and-file employees (sense 2)
- {末端|まったん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: retail price; street value (sense 3)
- {末端|まったん}⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧: end consumer (sense 3)

USAGE:
In news reports, {末端|まったん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ most often gives the street value of seized drugs: the price they would fetch when sold to users.
